messages.subject: issue with R workspace
parts:
Hello,

I have faced this problem when I tried to share a web application different from the built in example.

I created a folder in the directory "sample-apps" containing my server.R and ui.R files

When I try to launch it I get this error: "Error in setwd(appDir) : cannot change working directory Calls: runApp -> <Anonymous> -> setwd Execution halted"

I think that there are some issues with the path of the data set that I'm trying to visualize in my shiny application. I have a saved workspace with all the data but I don't know where to save it to be "seen" by shiny server.

Could anyone please give me some help?
Thank you in advice,

Andrea Bassi

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: issue with R workspace
parts:
Let's try this:

- Copy your .RData file (let's call it mydata.RData) into the Shiny application folder (where server.R and ui.R are located)
- On top of your server.R, use load("mydata.RData")
- Stop and start Shiny Server (just to be sure you start a fresh R process)
- Launch your application

Sorry if this is what you have already been doing. Since I haven't seen your code, I just wanted you to try this and see if this works.

There are different ways to save and load your data, which you can read about online. (Refer to Help documents on "save", "save.image", and "load")

You can also add "load("path_to_data_file")" in a .Rprofile file in the user's home directory. This file is read when a new R process starts, and loads the data specified in the command. Just remember that in Shiny Server, by default, R process is owned by "shiny" user. So the .Rprofile file needs to be in /home/shiny directory, unless you have made changes to your Shiny Server configuration.

If you are still having trouble with this, send us your application code (you can send it in a private email if you prefer).

Best,
Fereshteh
